description: A long project name (here the 120-character junk name) is not truncated in the board header. It spills 383px past its container and is drawn underneath and over the avatar stack, the Invite button and the You button, making all of them illegible.
expected: The header project name truncates with an ellipsis (full name in the switcher and a title tooltip) and never overlaps other controls.
actual: Geometry: div.client-identity spillPx 383; screenshot shows text through Invite and "You: Tomás Ruiz".
suggested_fix: Give the switcher button min-width:0, overflow:hidden, text-overflow:ellipsis, and a max-width tied to the header grid.

description: Pasting the invitation prompt into Project name on the default Start tab creates a project named "Join project "Payments ledger migration" with my own identity. Set up or reuse my local client, register yourself as my" (cut mid-sentence at 120 characters). Nothing detects the pardner-invite-v1 payload, and the project cannot be renamed or deleted (no UI or CLI command), so it stays in the switcher permanently, sharing the word "Payments" with the real project.
expected: Start detects an invitation ("This looks like an invitation. Join instead?") and switches to Join with the text moved over.
actual: Junk project created; switcher lists it as a four-line item between Homelab and the real project.
suggested_fix: Detect `pardner-invite-v1.` or multi-line text in the name field and offer Join; add rename/archive.

description: After the hub came back and the header returned to "Saved locally · synced", the switcher still listed "Payments ledger migration — Saved locally · waiting for hub". The same stale label was visible right after the join (step 14).
expected: Switcher labels follow the live status.
actual: Stale "waiting for hub" next to a synced header.

description: In the Invite dialog's history row, the state "Waiting to be used" wraps onto two lines while the same phrase sits on one line above.
expected: State chips stay on one line.
suggested_fix: white-space:nowrap on the state cell or a shorter label ("Unused").
